implementation: Adapt Sloppy adjacent integer compare/select fusion and direct destination-register conditional moves. Select values directly from copy-only arms instead of introducing redundant virtual-register moves. Preserve lazy evaluation and restrict speculative arms to the existing cheap pure integer operations.
adaptation: The Dewy optimizer already forms select expressions. Its copy-only arm results now directly supply the operands, exposing adjacent comparisons to the emitter without moving comparisons across intervening instructions. Other Sloppy lowering and optimization changes are not imported.

reference_stage.purpose: Fixed stage reference; do not replace with a slower implementation.
